step.cmd: In the X-Author Contracts pane, go to Work > Playbook.
Highlight the content of the contract to be marked as a clause.
Search the clause you want to add or select the clause from the available clauses list and click the more icon next to the clause name.

info.p: By marking the text as a clause in your agreement document, the text adopts the properties of the marked clause. You can even choose to replace text in the agreement with text from a pre-existing clause in your Playbook. When the agreement document is checked in and reconciled to the agreement record, information on marked clauses is added to the Agreement Clauses related list.

note.p: Clauses can only be smart in the context of single generated or offline Apttus agreement document.
